body:
MEASURED REPOSITORY SEAM, read-only follow-up.

storymodel4s contains no @main/def main/IOApp entrypoint. Its current direct-text API is already the correct pure core:
StorySource.fromText(String) -> SurfaceAnalyzer.analyze -> SurfaceAtlasArtifactCodec.encode.

storyatlas4s/AGENTS.md explicitly defines storyatlas4s as the application and renderer-adapter repository, and its existing JVM cli/Main.scala owns process arguments, filesystem output, exit codes, and the self-contained HTML edition. Therefore the next PATH|- implementation should extend that existing StoryAtlas CLI and add the immutable storymodel4s codec pin/dependency; creating a second CLI module in storymodel4s would duplicate ownership and violate the present module contract.

Likely separately reserved paths for a chief-approved next slice are storyatlas4s build.sbt, cli/Main.scala, and a focused Main input suite. Main.run should accept an injected InputStream for stdin courts, strict-decode bytes before StorySource construction, keep stdout artifact-only, send errors to stderr, never echo story content, and refuse an explicit output path that aliases the input source. HTML/source-preview paths remain a later reservation.

This narrows the earlier question: PATH|- is the desired mechanism; StoryAtlas is the owning wrapper. No sibling source or tracker state was changed.
